title: The Pinata Gauntlet! III
description: The Pinata Gauntlet! III — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Excited Lad

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 2 Pinatas and 8 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Excited Lad

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy 2 Pinatas and 8 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Next up is a twofor. This should be a good test of your ability as a Pinateer. Many have tried, and many succeeded, but will you fail so bad that you will be embarrassed to show your face in Townston? I hope not, everyone knows by now that you are my favorite Dungeon Runner.

Go to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag to begin your quest. Once you get there you are going to have to destroy the Pinata twice and the Pinata Turrets eight times. Good luck, Dungeon Runner!

Turn-in:

You did it! I can't believe *YOU* did it! Of all the people to do it, you did! You! Who knew?!

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas
  • Destroy Pinata Turrets

Level range: 85–100
